01

“the companions of the cave and the inscription [raqim]”

An explanation transmitted from Kaʿb (Q 18:9).

536
Explanation from Kaʿb No. 536: 1: 6

Kaʿb

English
Transmission wording
536: 1:6. Sufyan, from Simak ibn Harb, from Ikrima, from Ibn Abbas, that he asked Kab about the words of God
"the companions of the cave and the inscription [raqim]." As Kab said, it is the village (verse 9).
العربية
536: 1: 6 سفيان عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ عَنْ عكرمة عن بن عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ كَعْبًا عَنْ قول الله أصحاب الكهف والرقيم كما قال كعب هي القرية (الآية 9) .
Edition record 371416 · p. 177Link to report ↗

English

Ibrāhīm

English
Transmission wording

"keep yourself patient with those who call upon their Lord morning and evening, desiring His face": He said, the five prayers (verse 28).
العربية
539: 4: 9 سُفْيَانُ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ في قوله نَفْسَكَ مَعَ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ بالغدوة والعشي يريدون وجهه قال الصلوات الخمس (الآية 28) .

08

“so We will not assign to them on the Day of Resurrection any weight”

An explanation transmitted from Kaʿb ibn ʿUjra (Q 18:105).

548
Explanation from Kaʿb ibn ʿUjra No. 548: 13: 31

Kaʿb ibn ʿUjra

English
Transmission wording
548: 13:31. Sufyan, from al-Amash, from Shamir ibn Atiyya, from Abu Yahya, from Kab ibn Ujra, who said:
A man will be brought on the Day of Resurrection and will not weigh as much as the wing of a gnat. Then he recited "so We will not assign to them on the Day of Resurrection any weight" (verse 105).
العربية
548: 13: 31 سفيان عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ شَمْرِ بْنِ عَطِيَّةَ عَنْ أَبِي يَحْيَى عَنْ كعب بن عجرة قال يوتا عنه يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ بِالرَّجُلِ فَلَا يَزِنُ جَنَاحَ بَعُوضَةٍ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ فَلا نُقِيمُ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَزْنًا (الآية 105) .
Edition record 371418 · p. 179Link to report ↗

550
Explanation from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr No. 550: 15: 11

Saʿīd ibn Jubayr

English
Transmission wording
550: 15:11. Sufyan, from al-Rabi ibn Abi Rashid, from Said ibn Jubayr:
"whoever hopes for the meeting with his Lord": He said, the reward of his Lord; "let him do righteous work and not associate anyone in the worship of his Lord": he said, let him not show off (verse 110).
